data.name: Khuraym
data.gender_notes: Khuraym is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khuraimah' which means thunderbolt or lightning. This name is mentioned in the Quran in the story of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) and his son Isma'il (AS) when they were building the Ka'bah. Allah sent a thunderbolt to test their faith and commitment, and they remained steadfast. The name Khuraym carries the meaning “Thunderbolt” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khuraym usually hope their child will grow to embody thunderbolt and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of faith and steadfastness in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Khuraym belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thunderbolt.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khuraym total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: خريم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من خرم، يعني المبارك أو السعيد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خريم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'خ-ر-م' والذي يحمل معاني البركة والسعادة. في اللغة العربية، يعني خريم المبارك أو السعيد. وقد ورد هذا الاسم في بعض المصادر الإسلامية كاسم ذو دلالة إيجابية، يرمز إلى الخير والنماء.

in_urdu.name: خریم
in_urdu.meaning: خیر و برکت کا مطلب، مبارک یا خوش قسمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: خریم نام عربی جڑ 'خ-ر-م' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے برکت یا مبارکی۔ اردو میں، یہ نام خوش قسمت یا مبارک کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایت میں، یہ نام اچھی خاصی پذیرائی پزیر ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: खुरैम
in_hindi.meaning: ख़ैर और बरकत का अर्थ, مبارक या खुशकिस्मत
in_hindi.long_meaning: खुरैम नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'خ-ر-م' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है आशीर्वाद या مبارकी। हिंदी में, यह नाम مبارक या खुशकिस्मत के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, इस नाम का विशेष महत्व है।

in_pashto.name: خريم
in_pashto.meaning: د خیر او برکت معنی، مبارک یا خوشحال
in_pashto.long_meaning: خريم نوم د عربي ريښو 'خ-ر-م' څخه مشتق دی، کوم چې د برکت او خوښۍ معنی لري. په پښتو کې، دا نوم مبارک يا خوشحال د معنی لپاره کارول کيږي. د افغان او پښتنو دود کې، دا نوم د پام وړ دی.

in_english.name: Khuraym

in_english.long_meaning: The name Khuraym originates from the Arabic root 'خ-ر-م', conveying meanings of blessing, happiness, or good fortune. Historically, it has been used in Islamic tradition to signify a person who brings or receives blessings. The name symbolizes positivity and divine favor.

This name reminds us of their unwavering trust and obedience to Allah, and serves as an inspiration for us to remain steadfast in the face of trials and adversities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Khuraym" holds deep spiritual significance as it reminds us of the testing nature of Allah and the importance of remaining steadfast in faith. By reflecting on the story of Prophet Ibrahim and Isma'il, we are encouraged to strengthen our faith, and to put our trust in Allah, knowing that He alone can provide us with strength and guidance in times of hardship. The name also symbolizes the power and majesty of Allah, reminding us of His might and ability to bring about change through His divine will.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, vol. 11, p. 310 The name Khuraym carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Khuraym ibn Hisham al-Asadi was a poet who supported the pagan Arab tribe of Aws against Islam during the time of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He wrote a poem mocking the Prophet and calling for the destruction of the Muslim community in Medina. The Prophet responded by sending an emissary to Khuraym, who converted to Islam upon meeting the emissary and later became a prominent companion of the Prophet.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Tabari's Tarikh al-Rusul wa Al- Muluk, vol. 3, p. 221 The name Khuraym carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Khuraym ibn Zuraarah was a poet among the Banu Hashim who mocked the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the Battle of Uhud. After the Muslims suffered a setback in the battle, Khuraym wrote a poem expressing his triumph and mocking the Muslims for their defeat. This further provoked the pagan tribes to attack the Muslims. The Prophet (pbuh) responded by sending an emissary to Khuraym, who was captured and killed by the Muslims during the Battle of Hunayn.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Khuraym' is derived from Islamic folklore and is often associated with apocalyptic literature and horror genres. It is mentioned in various Islamic texts as a destructive figure who is said to bring about the end of times. In modern context, Khuraym's name is seen on various platforms such as literature, film and television, and social media. In literature, it is often used as a character or plot device in horror stories or apocalyptic narratives. In film and television, it has been featured in several productions, including the Syfy channel's 'Ghost Hunters' and the Turkish drama series 'Khuraym'. On social media, the name is frequently used in discussions about end-of-times prophecies, apocalyptic literature, and horror genres.
